name: the research slice kind and Aside-driven browser verification
objective: Add `research` to the closed SLICE_KINDS set as a findings-only slice -- no product code, always routed to slice-executor-high -- whose output lands in phase.md so the DECOMP2 slice that normally follows can re-cut the remaining work from what was learned, generalizing the second decomposition pass beyond the build-after design style. And make Aside (CLI / MCP / REPL) the workspace's prescribed instrument for real-browser verification -- the functional sweep, fidelity slices, and the review's own product walk -- in place of scripted Playwright-style automation. Ships as workspace v36.

acceptance.note: Workspace machinery only -- SLICE_KINDS, contract prose, agent/skill files and seed doc bodies. This repo ships no browsable product, so there is no running surface for the operator to open; the phase's effects are CLI and contract behaviour, verified by validate and the retrofit smoke tests.
